hook.line: The secret is out anyway, so I might as well tell you: YouTube is the best platform for AEO.
hook.visual: Selfie-style close-up by a sunny window, big smile and hand wave; a small blue 'YouTube for AEO' label at the top and bold word-by-word captions

beats.what: 'Secret is out' opener, then the claim: YouTube is the best platform for AEO
Defines AEO as getting your business named in AI search results
Contrast with old SEO: blog posts to reach the top spot on Google
Turn: now everyone competes for that traffic inside AI answers
Proof story: a big company found him via ChatGPT as a top person for YouTube ads
Problem: blog articles stopped working because anyone can make them with AI
Answer: real talking-head video on YouTube is what AI can't fake
Reason: LLMs need data and can train on public YouTube transcripts; open-hand gesture to camera
Soft pitch to the training pinned in his profile
Close: follow for more AI and marketing tips

why_it_works: 'The secret is out' framing makes the claim feel like insider information, so the viewer stays for the reveal
A personal proof story (a client found him through ChatGPT) turns an abstract trend into a concrete result
Highlighted keyword in each caption chunk keeps the eye moving on a single unchanging shot
Old-way vs new-way contrast (blogs vs video) gives a clear reason the advice matters now
weaknesses: 178 s with no cuts, no zooms and only two measured motion events; long stretches with nothing new to see
No screenshot of the ChatGPT result he describes, so the proof is told, not shown
Rambling filler ('you know', 'right') slows the middle third
for_robert: Steal the 'secret is out' opener, but show the proof: have Fred hold up the actual AI answer screenshot when the story lands instead of talking over a static shot.
